findings.evidence: Lines 129–135 define arbitrary-group transport solely as (P.compl₂ L).comp L; Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Hom/Instances.lean:278–283 already provides compl₂ and compl₂_apply.
findings.fix: Relocate and export them in a general pairing module, or replace their uses with the existing composition API.
findings.issue: The private transportPairing and transportPairing_apply are general infrastructure: their statements and proofs have no dependency on Conrey characters.

findings.evidence: Declarations occur here at line 58 and in NumberTheory/DirichletCharacter/Conrey.lean:256,308; each reduces a pairing-equals-one proposition to equality of its input with 1.
findings.issue: The characteristic reductions zmodPairing_eq_one_iff, conreyLocal_eq_one_iff, and conreyPairing_eq_one_iff lack @[simp], leaving trivial-pairing tests opaque to downstream simplification.

summary: Characteristic normal-form lemmas lack simplifier annotations, and general pairing infrastructure is hidden inside the Conrey implementation.
